name: mesh-model
description: A 3D model from a glTF, OBJ or STL file (Blender exports glTF) as lit faces the 3D camera orbits. Use in an Episode3D.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: a .glb, .gltf, .obj, .stl or .ply file, or (vertices, faces) arrays

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: the model's largest side in scene units

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: theme colour for faces the model gives no colour

parameters.name: max_faces
parameters.description: simplify to at most this many triangles, 4 to 5000; fewer renders faster

parameters.name: up
parameters.description: the source's up axis: "y" for glTF and OBJ, "z" for STL and CAD

parameters.name: wire
parameters.description: draw face edges in the background colour, for a low-poly look

parameters.name: shading
parameters.description: "lit" (default): manimvox's own lighting, colours stay true; "manim": Manim's shading, which washes towards white and draws slower

parameters.name: light
parameters.description: direction towards the light as the viewer sees it (x right, y up, z toward the viewer); default upper left, in front

parameters.name: ambient
parameters.description: 0 to 1: the share of its colour a face turned from the light keeps

returns: VGroup of faces with .mesh, .parts and .centres; mesh_part(model, name, inside) picks the faces of one part
